messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Org 'papertrailx' traffic spike detected. QPS ~8.2k (baseline ~400). Elevated 429/5xx observed on /v1/webhook/ingest. Auto-backpressure partially applied to protect shared pools. Creating thread for on-call mitigation coordination.

alice.m: I'm oncall, taking this. Observed errors in tracing, will follow traffic-mitigation runbook.

ben_sre: Confirmed — 429 spike started ~T-7m, large bursts from a handful of IP CIDRs. Logs show aggressive retry loops from one client token.

carla_support: Pinged PaperTrailX Ops (ticket #PTX-452). Shared short note: "We're applying targeted mitigations to keep service up; you may see reduced throughput for a short window."

devops-lead: Proposal: short-lived org QPS bump + traffic shaping for problematic clients + disable non-essential transforms for this org. Command to apply QPS bump: `rdctl org set-qps --org papertrailx --qps 10000 --ttl 3600`

alice.m: Running that now from runbook stage 2. Also adding a per-token denylist for obvious bad UA patterns.

incident-bot: rdctl change accepted: papertrailx qps=10000 ttl=3600 (previous 500). Applying in progress across edge proxies.

ben_sre: After bump: 429 rate down from ~18% -> ~2% within 60s. CPU on gpu-pool-3 increased ~15%. Latency p95 up ~80ms, still within SLO.

account-team: I'll open a temporary billing guardrail for PaperTrailX so they don't accidentally spike charges. Notifying AM.

devops-lead: Also pushing a targeted rate-filter to throttle user-agent matching `^crawler-bot/` to 1rps; snippet: `rate-filter add --org papertrailx --ua '^crawler-bot/' --limit 1`

oncall-sre: Applied UA filter, verified in logs: offending UA reduced by ~70%. Adding Grafana panel to watch 5xx/429 and pool CPU.

carla_support: PaperTrailX Ops replied: root cause is a misconfigured retry backoff in their webhook workers. They expect a fix in ~40m. Appreciative of quick mitigation.

alice.m: Disabled feature flag `realtime-transforms` for papertrailx to cut heavy CPU work: `flags set papertrailx realtime-transforms=false`. Also disabled KV prefill for them.

ben_sre: Observed token usage drop and CPU trending down. 5xx now ~0.6%. Leaving alert thresholds tightened for next 30m.

devops-lead: Plan for rollback: automatically revert QPS bump at TTL expiry. Manual rollback earlier if error rate rises or if pools taxed >80% sustained. Runbook note added: if 5xx >5% for 5m, hard-set org limit to 2000 and page infra lead.

alice.m: Adding post-incident notes to thread. Will keep monitoring for 1 hour and coordinate postmortem if needed.

incident-bot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up in 60m for status and AAR.

carla_support: Sent customer update: "We've applied traffic controls to stabilize your ingestion pipeline; your engineers are on a fix. We'll follow up when full traffic is restored." :thumbsup:

oncall-sre: Marking this mitigated for now. Leaving thread open until TTL expires / client confirms.

alice.m: :white_check_mark: Mitigation stable, handoff to morning oncall in 38m if issues persist.
